runtime_changes.google_auth: Propagates synchronous and early refresh settings through supported credential types. Starport explicitly uses DisableAsyncRefresh=true in cloudchain/google.go. The change restores that requested contract across the upstream paths.
runtime_changes.google_secretmanager: Moves iterator helpers from the Go 1.23 build-tagged file to the main generated file. Starport uses AccessSecretVersion. The required Go version remains below the project pin.
runtime_changes.aws_core: Adds a chunked decoding implementation. Caller changes and object tests still require qualification.
runtime_changes.aws_s3: Adds the existing embedded-error handler to nine operations, including Starport PutObject, HeadObject, and DeleteObject paths. Error normalization and object storage checks remain required.
runtime_changes.aws_checksum: Enables supported checksum validation for successful partial-content responses. Missing-checksum logs move to debug. The caller must consume the response for checksum verification.
runtime_changes.urfave_cli: Adds opt-in deprecation warnings, fixes Unicode option classification, inverse-boolean occurrence counts, and configured string-map key trimming. Starport does not use inverse flags or map flags in its CLI. CLI and generated documentation checks remain required.
runtime_changes.remaining_modules: Version metadata, dependency declarations, and changelog updates.

next_action: After #388 merges, update #389 from actual main. Run affected cloudchain, secret, object, and CLI checks with the PR dependency graph. Complete the pre-PR gate and exact-head native CI before merge.
